description:
As a Logistics & Technical Testing Representative at Webbing, you will be responsible for overseeing various logistics activities, inventory management, order processing (including exports and shipments), and customer backend setup within a platform developed by Webbing.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing the customer order process.
  • Handling Webbing's inventory.
  • Reviewing and approving invoices.
  • Import/Export processes, and collaboration with local and global authorities.
  • Managing customer setup and any related changes.
  •  Perform connectivity testing for new internal/ external SIM/eSIM orders. 
  • Conduct testing and validation of new IMSI sponsors and IMSI ranges.
  • Perform testing and validation of new MSISDN ranges.
  • Document test results, maintain testing records, and coordinate with relevant technical teams to resolve issues identified during testing.

 


Requirements

  • Proficiency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills - a must
  • Basic telecom knowledge, connectivity testing, and troubleshooting skills - a must
  • Good MS Excel skills (VLOOKUP, match, pivot) - a must
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
  • Organized and detail orientated with excellent prioritization skills.
  • Experience in warehouse management/Supply chain/Operations coordinator - an advantage
  • Experience with import/ export shipments - an advantage
  • Understanding of mobile roaming flows – an advantage
  • Knowledge with ERP systems -an advantage

About Webbing

Founded in early 2010, Webbing is a global data MVNO that delivers enterprise grade, global connectivity and IoT services across more than 200 countries and 600+ mobile carriers' networks. Webbing's secured network delivers network protection and web content intelligence.

Enterprise customers can manage, monitor, and optimize data usage in real-time with Webbing's powerful software platform. Gain visibility by application type and have the power to white list applications and limit non-business applications with the click of a button, saving money and improving compliance.


What we offer

  • An exciting and challenging workplace with great skill and knowledge development opportunities.
  • The opportunity to join a team of highly professional specialists in an international environment.
  • The opportunity for professional development within a reputable international innovative and growing company.
  • Meal Vouchers.
  • Medical insurance.
